description: This file defines the BuzzLikeDao class, which manages data access operations related to 'likes' on shares and comments within the Buzz module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving 'like' entities, with filtering and pagination support.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing 'likes' on shares and comments in Buzz.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity to the database.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a like on a share based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a like on a comment based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity based on share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching given search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Counts the number of BuzzLikeOnShare entities matching search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching given search filters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Counts the number of BuzzLikeOnComment entities matching search filters.
